title: Process Section
description: Numbered steps of how you work, in two layouts (rows, grid), that takes its colours and fonts from the project's design system

layouts.title: Rows
layouts.description: One step per row, its number in a badge beside the title and description, a rule joining the badges; the default.

layouts.title: Grid
layouts.description: The steps in one, two or three columns as the width grows, each number badge above its title.

proof: installs alone on Next 16; two layouts (rows, grid); two-digit numbers fit their badge; 3 sample brands, light and dark, at 390/768/1280 px in two host apps; axe clean; no leak
postMessage: See components/section-process/README.md for the layouts, the design tokens it reads and the content props.
